input.answer: I'd go with A, the two tall columns. 66,513 ₪ for the keren next to 19,595 ₪ for a regular investment account, with the big yellow "הפקדות המעסיק 54,000 ₪" block, told me straight away that joining is worth it. B shows the same numbers, but it's a staircase of separate blocks and I had to hop from one to the next.

stuck.where: Option A, top of the keren column (the striped block, 'מס במשיכה −13,974 ₪')
stuck.why: It sits on top of the column like it's part of it, but has a minus. I wasn't sure if the 66,513 already has it taken off. I guessed yes, because the white bracket stops below it.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the repeated chart for year 6 (98,738 ₪, tax 0 ₪)
stuck.why: Suddenly a different big number. At first I thought it was another option, then saw it's 'אותו ציור שנה אחת אחר כך', the same drawing one year later. It's a bit confusing next to the 66,513 that stuck in my head.
